findings.description: As the camera pulls back, two distinct hands are seen emerging from the single left sleeve of the man's blue suit. One hand is holding a coin above the cup, while a second hand is resting near the rim. By 00:03, the upper hand holding the coin disappears completely, leaving only the lower hand.
